Hi Markus,

Thanks for the quick intro in the kickoff yesterday. We've got the legal sign-off and are ready to get the tenant created and seeded so our devs can run an initial integration test next week. High-level asks: 
- Single workspace scoped to BrightArc (no sub-tenants)

Hi Aisha — great to hear the legal green light.

We're set to provision the workspace. Proposed plan (ETA and owners):
1) Workspace creation + admin invite (Markus) — within 24 hours after we receive the signed SOW and preferred admin email.
2) API key seeding (Monica) — will create two scoped service keys (dev/staging). Keys will be posted to your secure SFTP link or uploaded to your Vault; let us know preference.
3) Role mapping + invite cadence (David) — will create an "Engineer" role that has embeddings + generation scopes, and an "Org Admin" role for your Aisha.
4) Smoke test + sample curl snippets (Tessa) — we will run a quick acceptance test and email the snippets for your devs to validate.

Action items for BrightArc: please confirm admin email and your preference for key delivery (SFTP vs. Vault). Also confirm if you need IP allowlisting for the staged keys.

I'll start the workspace creation once Monica confirms the key templates. Looping Monica and David for intake.

Thanks,

Subject: Re: BrightArc provisioning — API templates and scopes

Markus / team,

I drafted the two key templates and mapped scopes. Summary: 
- dev-key: scopes = [embedding.read, generate.chat.read], ephemeral TTL 30d, no IP restrictions by default
- staging-key: scopes = [embedding.read, generate.chat, generate.chat.stream], TTL 90d, optional IP allowlist

I'll bundle the keys and a short README with sample curl/postman snippets. For delivery, Vault is preferred; we can create a BrightArc Vault mount and invite your admin (Aisha) with access restricted to the two keys. If BrightArc prefers SFTP, we can temporarily drop the keys there and rotate after handoff.

Also — do we want to enable the "prefix caching" option for embeddings? It reduces token usage for repeated prefixes but requires a short onboarding note to the devs. Recommend ON for staging.

Planned timeline: create workspace this afternoon, seed keys tonight, invites tomorrow morning PST, smoke test tomorrow afternoon. I'll publish a short acceptance checklist in the shared Drive link.

Cheers,
Monica Patel
Implementation Lead | Redwood Inference
